steps: Sale A/B/C/D = 1,000,000; cash 600,000 + POS 400,000; stock for each falls 10 to 9; blue 1,000,000.
Return A for 100,000 cash; A returns to stock 10; blue 900,000.
Exchange B 200,000 to B1 180,000; 20,000 store credit; B restored, B1 decremented; blue 900,000.
Exchange C+D 700,000 to C1+D1 740,000; 40,000 cash collected; original C/D restored and replacement SKUs decremented; blue 940,000.
Re-exchange B1 180,000 from its own child invoice into B2 160,000; second separate 20,000 credit; B1 restored and B2 decremented; blue 940,000.
complexMultiItemChain.finalPhysicalReconciliation: cash received 640,000 + POS received 400,000 - cash refund 100,000 = blue 940,000

policyChecks.noMethod: Unconfirmed overpayment gate blocked without mutation; after confirmation and the dedicated credit authorization, no cash/POS payout occurred, exactly 250,000 backed non-expiring credit was created, and a delivery record remained PENDING.
policyChecks.livePartiallyUsedCredit: Returned share restored to the same ID/code; no successor created.
policyChecks.fullyUsedCredit: Original ID/code stayed USED; a distinct successor was created and the raw expiry timestamp matched.
policyChecks.multipleUsedSources: Two USED source shares produced exactly two distinct successors; no consolidation.
policyChecks.duplicateReturn: Blocked without changing cash movements, stock, or return-document count; official original document retained.
policyChecks.managerGates: Overpayment and credit-issuance authorizations tested independently; an unrelated manager password did not satisfy the credit gate.

harnessDevelopmentNotes: The first development run of the six-case runner exposed an incorrect expected return-document count (3 expected vs 4 actual valid documents); assertion was corrected, then the full chain passed.
The first no-method call omitted confirmOverpay and was correctly blocked without mutation; the final test now records this expected gate and then tests the authorized path.
An expiry fixture compared ISO text to the equivalent millisecond timestamp; fixture was corrected to a raw millisecond value, and exact source/successor expiry equality passed.

expectedRejections: No-method full return without the required overpayment confirmation.
Credit-limit/issuance operation using the wrong manager authorization channel.
Duplicate return of a fully returned item.
